version.note: The performing edition and any editorial alterations are not identified in the recording sources.

date.value: 24 April 1929 (the movement’s second side, CVE-48986); the first side’s date is not established
date.note: DAHR’s list of recordings made on 24 April 1929 includes Victor matrices CVE-48986, -48987 and -48988 for Koussevitzky’s Symphony No. 94. A discography lists the first movement’s part 2 as CVE-48986, take 2. The matrix of part 1 is not established here, so the movement-level date is inferred from one of its two sides. Commons’ 1 January 1929 is not a session day.

place.value: Symphony Hall, Boston, Massachusetts, United States
place.note: DAHR gives Symphony Hall, Boston for the Andante side CVE-48984 of the same set; the pages for the 24 April matrices could not be opened, so the place for this movement is inferred from the set.

catalogue.value: Set M-55; the disc number of this movement’s sides is not established
catalogue.note: The upstream transfer identifies the original Victor set as M-55 (Internet Archive description). The Andante sides are on disc 7059 per DAHR; disc numbers for this movement were not found.

matrixTakeSides.value: CVE-48986, take 2 (Vivace assai, part 2); the matrix of part 1 is not established
matrixTakeSides.note: The part 2 matrix and take are read from the Bolig discography; the DAHR matrix page could not be opened on 17 October 2026 (the database returned a 503 error). No run-out inspection has been made of the digital surrogate.

credits.value: Bob Varney — transfer from original Victor 78s

date.note: No transfer date is identified. The Internet Archive item was uploaded in December 2008, which is an upload date.

processing.value: Transfer from the original Victor 78 rpm set M-55 into one 20:48 file, from which the four movements were extracted as separate Commons files.
processing.note: The file lengths of the four Commons movements sum to the length of the Internet Archive file within about a second. The extraction procedure, stylus, playback curve, side-join locations and noise treatment are not documented.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative supplied by Wikimedia Commons; uploaded source: Ogg Vorbis

composition.value: Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies.
composition.note: Haydn died in 1809. This is a term calculation, not a worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern edition.

recording.value: Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis).
recording.note: Commons applies PD-EU-audio to the Koussevitzky/Boston recording attributed to 1929, and the Internet Archive item carries a Creative Commons public-domain licence URL, not treated here as authority to waive Victor’s rights. The programme’s pre-1963 European rule applies because the 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US status is not established, and the recording date is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.
